label: R-act1 from dependence through the two unde bridges, checked (inference)
rule: Chain dependence, actualization, reception and limitation at the nature
meaning: Take x whose nature is not being itself. Its nature is in act, so by R-dep x has being; by the first unde its nature is actual through esse; by the second, since the nature is not being itself, x's esse is received in its nature; received esse is limited. Own being is read as esse tantum (the nature is being itself). Given R-dep, the first bridge and the nature in act, the second bridge is equivalent to the reception half of the conclusion (undeLoadMap), so this derivation makes the commitment explicit.
